title: The canonical unbounded direct-image mate and its naturality
statement: For a commutative ring A and a scheme morphism g:X→Y, localize the canonical exact inverse-image square to obtain c:nu_Y^* g_proet^* ≅ g_et^* nu_X^*. Define alpha_K:nu_Y^* Rg_et,* K→Rg_proet,* nu_X^* K as the transpose, under g_proet^* ⊣ Rg_proet,*, of c at Rg_et,* K followed by nu_X^* of the etale derived counit. These are total right derived functors on K-injectives. This construction is natural in K.

source.place: Displayed canonical mate; naturality square in the Conclusion paragraph

proof.text: Apply the exact inverse images termwise and localize their canonical square. Define the component by adjunction transposition. For naturality, apply the naturality formulas for homEquiv on its source and target, then naturality of the pullback square and the etale derived counit.
